observations: Large outdoor stacks of blue plastic drums laid on their sides, dozens visible across both photos.
Drums show rust-colored staining, dirt, and weathering consistent with heavy prior use.
Small diamond-shaped hazard/warning stickers are visible on several drum ends (photo 0 left drum, photo 1 multiple drums), but text is too small/blurry to read.
Bung holes (small round openings) visible on drum ends; some appear open, caps not clearly visible.
Ground is bare dirt/mud, suggesting an open storage yard, not a showroom.
A watermark reading 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlays photo 1.
No single drum is isolated for close inspection; both shots are wide lot views.

claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of liquid
claims.evidence: No close-up shows interior condition, prior contents, or a food-grade/chemical-safe marking; hazard stickers present in photo 0 and photo 1 suggest possible prior industrial use, which contradicts a blanket 'any liquid' claim.

risks.risk: Drums may have previously held chemicals or hazardous substances (hazard stickers visible), making them unsafe for food or drinking water storage without proper cleaning certification.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the hazard label text and any stenciled markings on a representative drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/non-food-grade used drum, not suitable for potable liquid

risks.risk: Structural condition (cracks, thinning plastic, leaks) cannot be judged from a distance in a stacked pile.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of 2-3 individual drums, including base and seams, or a water-fill test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed leak-free / worst case condition

risks.risk: Caps or bungs may be missing or damaged, affecting usability for liquid storage.
risks.proof: Close-up of the bung/cap area on a sample drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete (no confirmed intact closure)

risks.risk: Buyer cannot confirm which specific drum(s) from the large stack will be delivered, risking receipt of a worse-condition unit than shown.
risks.proof: Seller provides photo of the exact unit(s) to be sold/delivered.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest visible condition in the lot

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the hazard/warning label text on a sample drum
Close-up photos of drum exterior (seams, base) for crack/leak signs
Photo of the bung/cap closure intact
Photo of the specific drum(s) to be handed over to the buyer
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as used plastic storage drums; despite unresolved condition and prior-use risks, these can be priced at worst case (non-food-grade, unverified leak status) pending further proof.
